Ayobami / Publication design

Give your content
a considered home.

I offer page-layout services for catalogs, magazines, brochures and business documents in Adobe InDesign. The aim is straightforward: make the content readable, coherent and appropriate for its audience.

This portfolio contains self-initiated publication studies. Each has a complete PDF and editable source files, so the layouts can be inspected beyond their presentation images.

Explore the work ↗

What I can help with

  • Product catalogs and lookbooks
  • Magazines and newsletters
  • Brochures and company profiles
  • Reports, proposals and white papers
  • Updates to existing InDesign documents

What to bring

Your final text, approved images, logo, brand guidelines, preferred page size and design references. For printed documents, include the printer’s specifications.

What we agree before work begins

Page count, file formats, review stages and revision scope. Writing, research, data analysis and custom illustration are separate services and need to be discussed explicitly.

A clear brief is a good beginning

What are you
putting on the page?

Share your content, page count and intended audience. We can discuss the format and what the final files need to do.
